irregularities.title: No free key-less odds source for cricket
irregularities.detail: ESPN returns an empty odds array for cricket competitions. OLBG shows tipster consensus counts, not bookmaker prices. The Odds API / Betfair require a key. The prompt's odds factors (win price, MoTM price, top-batsman price) therefore cannot be sourced without a key.
irregularities.mitigation: Every odds factor is scored as missing and recorded in missing[]; the writer withholds odds-dependent confidence. Supplying an Odds API key unlocks the already-written odds rules.

irregularities.title: Pitch reports and weather forecasts have no free structured source
irregularities.detail: The prompt weights pitch (spin/pace/batting) and rain heavily. No key-less JSON source publishes a machine-readable pitch report. ESPN/ESPNcricinfo editorial mentions surfaces but not a per-match structured field.
irregularities.mitigation: match.pitch is left null; pitch-dependent bonuses and the spin/pace matchup are recorded missing rather than guessed. Manually verified pitch notes could be added with a source link.

irregularities.title: Last-5 player aggregates are not exposed key-less
irregularities.detail: The summary endpoint gives full per-match scorecard data, but a single key-less call does not return a player's rolling last-5 runs/wickets. Building it requires walking prior events per player (many requests).
irregularities.mitigation: The live collector derives single-match figures and team form/H2H from the 30-day scorepanel tape; player last-5 aggregates are scored missing until a player-tape pass is enabled.

irregularities.title: Injuries, squad availability and social/analyst sentiment have no free structured source
irregularities.detail: The prompt asks for injury impact and X/ESPNcricinfo analyst sentiment used internally. There is no key-less structured feed for either.
irregularities.mitigation: Confirmed XIs come from the match summary roster (starters). Injury and sentiment factors are never guessed; they are omitted and listed missing.

irregularities.title: OLBG and ESPN fixtures use different team naming
irregularities.detail: OLBG lists short/county names (e.g. 'Northants', 'E Lewis') while ESPN uses full names; not every OLBG event maps to an ESPN event id automatically.
irregularities.mitigation: The OLBG overlay is matched on normalised team names with a tolerant includes() comparison; unmatched OLBG events still display on the Markets tab with their own review link rather than being force-joined.

irregularities.title: Odds are Americanised in the engine but absent in data
irregularities.detail: The prompt states thresholds in American odds (-250, +400..+900). The engine converts decimal to American and applies the prompt bands; with no prices present, those branches are inert until CR-IR-01 is resolved.
irregularities.mitigation: normaliseOdds() is unit-tested for decimal/American conversion; once a price feed exists the rules activate with no engine change.
